title: 第19章 我天生就是双修的命第20章 哥哥你的肾受得了吗
content_zh:
我决定去会会双胞胎。
有谷主令在手，没什么好忌惮的。
“你们想要击杀的男人，已经被我夺舍，仇恨可以放下了。”
先礼后兵。
如果她们愿意退一步，我也不会执着于要捅她们一刀。
“夺舍？”她们冷笑一声，语气里满是不屑，“我们只看脸！你准备后事吧。”
“速宁飞刀”再次破空而出，直逼我的下半身。
春兰和秋兰立刻在灵体小世界里做好了出击准备。
谷主令果然没让我失望，瞬间发出两道漩涡，稳稳收了她们的飞刀。
“真没得商量了？”
我还是希望她们能收手。
毕竟速家是有名望的名门正派，一呼百应。
我可不想被那些愣头青拿来积攒功德。
我可是价值1枚24级灵晶，这笔财富足以让任何人铤而走险。
“你换一具肉身，把这具肉身给我们出了气，仇恨就一笔勾销！”
“你们不知道这肉身对我有多重要。”
“那就没得商量了！”双胞胎齐声怒喝，声音里满是决绝。
她们叫得凶，却没再动手。
看来她们真的只会用飞刀，不懂其他招式。
趁她们的飞刀还没重新凝聚，我退了回来。

她们全属性24级，一口气就能把我吹成虚无。
不可力敌，只能智取。
我要等她们进入梦乡，在梦里彻底收了她们。
虽然修炼可以代替睡眠，但终究无法完全替代。
她们迟早会进入梦乡。
她们每天守在谷门口，大概觉得合欢谷是污秽之地，从未踏入半步。
我也没法离开合欢谷，只能耐心等待时机。
可几十天过去了，她们始终靠修炼代替休息，压根不睡觉。
……
菁秀提取敏书畅和阴乙丹肉身的记忆，过程并不顺利。
只能提取到很多年前的记忆，近期的记忆一片空白。
一珉推测，修炼到达一定层次后，记忆会由灵体承载，肉身不过是个躯壳。
这样一来，珍恋的消息就彻底断了。
按泣晶露的回忆，她是在珍恋刚到合欢谷那几天，被敏书畅掳来的。
很可能从那时起，珍恋就被带到了其他地方。
令人费解的是，泣晶露的容貌居然是天生的。
她不仅和珍恋长得一模一样，生日也完全相同。
她们明明身处间隔亿万光年的不同星球，这难道只是巧合？
通过双舞，我联系上了仙女宫宫主仙珈宁。
“你把双舞拐跑了，还有脸来见我？”仙珈宁依旧是“珍恋”的外貌，语气里带着几分嗔怒。

“姐姐这话就见外了，我和双舞是一起研习至高无上的双修功法，志同道合才走到一起的。”
content_en:
I decided to meet the twins.
With the Valley Master's order in hand, there is nothing to be afraid of.
"The man you want to kill has been taken away by me, so you can let go of your hatred."
Be polite before fighting.
If they are willing to take a step back, I won't insist on stabbing them.
"Seize the body?" They sneered, their tone full of disdain, "We only care about face! You can prepare your funeral."
The "Suning Flying Knife" shot out of the air again and hit my lower body.
Chunlan and Qiulan immediately prepared to attack in the small spiritual world.
The Valley Master's order did not disappoint me. He sent out two whirlpools in an instant and steadily collected their flying knives.
"Is there really no need to discuss it?"
I still hope they can stop.
After all, the Su family is a well-known and decent family, and they respond to every call.
I don't want to be used by those stupid young people to accumulate merit.
I am worth a level 24 spiritual crystal, and this wealth is enough to make anyone take risks.
"You can change your body to another one, vent your anger on us with this body, and the hatred will be wiped out!"
"You don't know how important this body is to me."
"Then there's no need to discuss it!" The twins shouted angrily in unison, their voices full of determination.
They screamed fiercely, but did not take action again.
It seems that they really only know how to use throwing knives and don't know other moves.
Before their flying knives could regroup, I stepped back.
All of their attributes are level 24, and they can blow me into nothingness in one breath.
Invincible, only outsmarted.
I want to wait for them to fall asleep and completely accept them in their dreams.
Although practicing can replace sleep, it cannot completely replace it.
Sooner or later they will fall asleep.
They guard the gate of the valley every day. They probably think Hehuan Valley is a filthy place and have never stepped foot inside.
I couldn't leave Hehuan Valley, so I could only wait patiently for the opportunity.
But dozens of days have passed, and they still rely on practicing instead of resting, not sleeping at all.
…
Jingxiu's process of extracting the memories of Min Shuchang and Yin Yidan's bodies was not smooth.
Only memories from many years ago can be retrieved, and recent memories are blank.
Yimin speculated that after cultivation reaches a certain level, memories will be carried by the spirit body, and the physical body is just a shell.
In this way, news about Zhen Lian was completely cut off.
According to Weeping Jinglu's memories, she was kidnapped by Min Shuchang in the days when Zhenlian first arrived in Hehuan Valley.
It is likely that Zhenlian was taken to other places since then.
What is puzzling is that Wei Jinglu's appearance is actually natural.
Not only does she look exactly like Zhen Lian, she also has the same birthday.
They are obviously on different planets hundreds of millions of light years apart. Is this just a coincidence?
Through the double dance, I contacted Xian Jianing, the master of the Fairy Palace.
"You kidnapped Shuang Wu and you still have the nerve to come see me?" Xian Jianing still looked like "Zhen Lian", with a hint of anger in her tone.
"Sister, what you said is obvious. Shuangwu and I studied the supreme dual cultivation technique together, and we got together because we share the same goals."
